test_name: Text clef anchored by cnb:clef-anchor-semitones under the pitch-axis hook (session 24)
description: The Twinline geometry of the Configurator's fixture (12 pitch classes on 7 axis positions, octave stride 7, sps 2, lines -6 -3 -1 1 4 6, middle G at position 0) with a 'text clef whose label is a filled 1x2 path markup at cnb:clef-size-semitones 4 (2 staff-spaces), anchored at cnb:clef-anchor-semitones 16.5. The anchor goes through the hook as a 'custom anchor does: 16.5 lies between E (16, position 5) and F (17, position 6), so it interpolates to position 5.5 half-staff-spaces, and the label's TOP edge must sit 2.75 staff-spaces above center_y (the linear formula would give 2.25). Measured 2026-11-10 on 2.24: top edge y = 7.296 against center_y 10.05 (expected 7.30).

assertions.description: The text clef is engraved in measure 1

assertions._comment: === SECTION 2: THE LABEL'S TOP EDGE AT THE HOOK'S POSITION FOR THE ANCHOR ===

assertions.description: The label's TOP edge lands at hook position 5.5 (anchor 16.5 interpolated between E and F) = 2.75 staff-spaces above the staff center, not the linear 2.25
The label keeps its size: 4 semitones at sps 2 = 2 staff-spaces tall (a length, not mapped through the hook)
The staff is the six-line Twinline staff, 6 staff-spaces tall
